title: TopologyActiveRelationshipInstance
description: Relationship instance already active in the scoped topology context, usually because the current view binding or an existing layer materialized it.

instanceId.description: Runtime identifier for this active relationship instance.

relationshipId.description: Stable topology relationship id represented by this active instance.

catalogIds.description: Semantic catalog ids associated with this active relationship instance, when known.

displayName.description: Short display label for the active instance.

status.description: Runtime status for this active relationship instance.

renderMode.description: Render mode currently used for this active relationship instance.

qualifiers.description: Qualifiers bound by this active relationship instance, for example vlanId=100.

viewBinding.description: Optional current topology-service view binding that produced this active instance. This is descriptive context; relationshipId remains the public capability identity.

layerIds.description: Overlay layer ids associated with this active relationship instance.

graphOverlayIds.description: Graph overlay ids associated with this active relationship instance.

diagnostics.description: Non-fatal diagnostics for this active relationship instance.
